A0I7.name: 眩晕
A0I7.tip: 风暴之锤(T) - [等级 1],风暴之锤(T) - [等级 2],风暴之锤(T) - [等级 3],风暴之锤(T) - [等级 4]
A0I7.ubertip: 向目标投掷一巨大的魔法斧，对其造成100点伤害并使其5秒内处于眩晕状态。,向目标投掷一巨大的魔法斧，对其造成200 点伤害并使其7秒内处于眩晕状态。,向目标投掷一巨大的魔法斧，对其造成300点伤害并使其9秒内处于眩晕状态。,向目标投掷一巨大的魔法斧，对其造成450点伤害并使其12秒内处于眩晕状态。

A14Y.name: 时空裂隙
A14Y.ubertip: 青铜龙探险者每隔5s，生命值会回到2s前的状态，同时下一次普攻会同时攻击4个单位造成100%的攻击力伤害

A14Z.name: 虫洞
A14Z.ubertip: 青铜龙守卫每隔4s，生命值会回到2s前的状态，同时下一次普攻会同时攻击4个单位造成150%的攻击力伤害

A150.name: 青铜龙分裂
A150.ubertip: 对周围的敌方空中单位进行强有力的弹幕攻击。每次发射能造成13 - 14点的伤害。

A151.name: 时间停滞
A151.ubertip: 青铜龙守卫的攻击（包括虫洞的分裂攻击）有20%的几率使被攻击目标停滞1.5s

nativeEvidence.supports: 0x14/0x15为主武器最小/最大攻击，公式base+bonus+dice与base+bonus+dice*sides。当前用对象范围与宿主直接攻击差值适配，动态原生bonus仍partial。
原生Aroc武器伤害、暴击抑制；完整目标数量的既有来源见native-barrage-evidence.json。

differences: building h0QO A14Y -> combat h0QQ A14Z; building h0QP A14Z -> combat h0QR A14Y,A151; registration reads building
period5/4 always reads phase2 history, not rolling two seconds
A150 damage P8 starts0, no ordinary eventdamage assignment, h0QR branch replaces to half randomattack in normal configuration
h0QQ/h0QR absent from Q self-registration; victim must be registered for attack-start counter to execute; Q parent1 registrations do not qualify
A150 count lives in sourcehashtable and is not reset when regranted
PauseUnitEx1.5 truncates stunlevel1 and separately freezes animation1.5
remaining: native Aroc missiles/targetorder, PRNG, dynamic native attackbonus and native-version checks
unimplemented P8-changing Varian/A16Z mixed-ability branches retained as unresolved, no guessed local damage
PauseUnitEx command arbitration and overlapping animationreset semantics
dead/removedhandle life value separate fromdeathstate; no fabricated resurrection
old snapshots without timer history do not receive invented history; a fresh deployment initializes it
Nozdormu hero A15A and A154/A155/A158 are outside this ordinary-unit batch and remain unresolved
AttackTrigegr的S006计时器与玩家2布尔值仅有宿主适配字段，混入其他家族时的共享状态仍待闭合；普通青铜龙配置不携带这些能力。

The host damage pipeline still conflates native rejected hits (invulnerability/immunity/evasion) with true zero events. Direct independent-listener calls can rewrite zero, but _hurt keeps its preexisting early-zero return and does not apply the returned override in that branch. Initial nonpositive damage also exits before listeners. Do not claim complete native zero-event production/ordering.
